china-1924-5:p0542_1.rationale: Direct trade values with each country 1918-1922, split into imports from and exports to each country; the rows are trade flows by partner.

china-1924-5:p0545_1.rationale: Continuation of the direct trade by country table (Australia, South Africa); ends with total imports, less re-exports to foreign countries, net imports and exports.

china-1924-5:p0546_1.rationale: Whole trade of each port (Aigun to Tientsin) in 1921 and 1922, split into net foreign imports, net Chinese imports and exports with port totals. It is port-level trade, not treaty-port institutional content.

china-1924-5:p0547_1.rationale: Continued whole trade by port (Lungkow to Yochow): net foreign imports, net Chinese imports, exports and totals.

china-1924-5:p0548_1.rationale: Continued whole trade by port (Hankow to Ningpo): net foreign imports, net Chinese imports and exports with port totals.

china-1924-5:p0549_1.rationale: Continued whole trade by port (Wenchow to Lappa, incl. Kowloon): imports, Chinese imports, exports and totals.

china-1924-5:p0550_1.rationale: Continued whole trade by port (Kongmoon to Szemao): net foreign imports, net Chinese imports, exports and totals for 1921 and 1922.

china-1924-5:p0551_1.rationale: Tengyueh plus grand totals of foreign imports, Chinese imports and exports, with value of exports abroad and home trade.

china-1924-5:p0552_1.rationale: Value of re-exports of foreign goods to each foreign country in 1921 and 1922, with direct and Hongkong totals.

china-1924-5:p0553_1.rationale: Carrying trade by flag in 1922: vessel entries, tonnage, foreign imports carried, import duties and tonnage dues. Combines shipping tonnage by nationality with trade values and duties.
